name: Differentiable Marching Cubes
aliases: Flexible Isosurface Extraction for Gradient-Based Mesh Optimization
definition: A differentiable meshing algorithm that divides 3D space into a deformable grid and takes a scalar field (often SDF) defined on its vertices as input to generate an explicit watertight manifold mesh.
summary: Differentiable Marching Cubes is a mesh extraction method that optimizes learnable grid deformations and per-cube weights to produce significantly smoother surfaces than static alternatives.
